style.prompt:
Design a refined minimalist event flyer with excellent clear typography. Soft earthy colours: warm ivory paper background, muted terracotta, sand and sage. A simple elegant hand-drawn line illustration of a clay bowl, not a photo, centered beneath the event title. Calm artisan studio aesthetic, ample negative space, flat print design, no mockup. All elements must fit in a centered compact composition suitable for subsequent reformatting into a portrait 4:5 flyer. Include EXACTLY these five text lines, with accurate spelling and punctuation, and NO OTHER WORDING, logos or watermarks:
Pottery Workshop
Clay House Studio
24 July 2027
14:00–16:00
Beginners welcome
Make Pottery Workshop the largest title; other information beautifully balanced and easy to read.
